spans.s: uddha-grāma (LP), the village of which the revenue is fixed in a lump sum.
uddha-khila-bhūmi (LP), table land which is uncultivated (khila). But cf. uddha-grāma.

uddhāra (LP), borrowed on trust or credit; cf. udhār.
 (IE 8-5), same as udraṅga; cf. Tamil uttāra.
uddhāra-proddhāra (LP), taking on credit; cf. Marāṭhī udhār-pādhār.
uddhārya (LP), ‘may be debited’; cf. Gujarātī udhāra-vuṃ.
uddhārya-vyavahāra (LP), the business of lending money.
